constraints: -1j * jnp.tan(1j * x) is equivalent to jnp.tanh(x)
jax.npy.tanh(x) and -1j * jnp.tan(1j * x) should have the same dtype
jax.npy.tanh() supports complex64, float32, and float64 dtypes for x

output.description: An array containing the hyperbolic tangent of each element of ``x``, promoting to inexact dtype.
